chapters.title: AI File Sources
chapters.subtitle: Keep an assistant's knowledge in step with a folder

steps.text: Much of a company's knowledge lives in folders that another system keeps up to date, such as nightly exports on an F.T.P. site. This video shows how a file source reads a folder on a schedule, and keeps an assistant's knowledge current, without anyone uploading a file.
Documents that change often, such as handbooks, price sheets and product exports, go stale when someone has to upload each new version.
Often another system already writes them to a folder: on the site's server, on an F.T.P. site, or on an S.F.T.P. site.
A file source reads that folder on a schedule, and turns each file into passages that the assistant can search.
Only new, changed and removed files are processed, so the knowledge follows the folder.

chapters.title: How it is organized
chapters.subtitle: An index, a data source, a file source

steps.text: Three pieces work together. A knowledge base index stores the passages, so the assistant can search them by meaning.
A Files data source is the target: the knowledge base that the assistant answers from.
A file source is the reader. It has a connector for a folder on the server, an F.T.P. site, or an S.F.T.P. site.
Then you choose the data source on a profile, and the assistant answers from the files, with sources.
First, the knowledge base index. Open Search, Indexes, click Add index, and click Add on AI Knowledge Base Index for Elasticsearch.
Enter an Index Name and a Name, and pick the Embedding deployment. It cannot be changed after the index is created.
Click Save. Data sources, file sources and web crawlers all store their passages in an index like this one.

chapters.title: Create a Files data source
chapters.subtitle: The target of the file source

steps.text: Open Artificial Intelligence, Data Sources, and click Add Data Source.
In Available Source Types, click Add on Files. It is the target for file sources.
Enter a Name, and choose the Destination index, the knowledge base index that stores the passages. It cannot be changed after you save.
Click Save. The data source is listed, and waits for a file source to fill it.
Open Artificial Intelligence, File Sources, and click Add File Source.
In Available Connectors, click Add on File system, which reads a folder on the site's server.
Enter a Name, and choose the Target File data source, the one you just made. Several file sources can feed the same data source.

Keep Enabled ticked, so that the scheduled reading runs. Re-read interval is how often the folder is read again, in minutes. The site checks once an hour, so a shorter interval still runs at most hourly.
Figures says whether the charts and pictures inside documents are described: Auto, All or Off. Describing figures uses a vision model, so it costs more. The other fields can stay as they are.
Folder is the folder to read, inside the file sources area that your technical team set aside for this site. Tick Include sub-folders to read the folders below it too.
Click Save. The list shows the source with its connector, and Never run as its last run.

chapters.title: Read the folder
chapters.subtitle: Run it now, and see the result

steps.text: To read the folder right away, open the Actions menu of the source and click Read now.
After a moment, the Last run column shows what happened: how many files were found, ingested, unchanged, removed and failed.
Here all three files were ingested. From now on, the schedule keeps the data source in step with the folder.

chapters.title: Read an F.T.P. or S.F.T.P. server
chapters.subtitle: The other connectors

steps.text: For a file server, click Add on SFTP in the Available Connectors. Enter the Host, the Port, which is 22 by default, and the Username.
Sign in with a Password, or paste a Private key and its Key passphrase. They are stored encrypted, and never shown again.
Folder is the folder on the server to read. Files per listing caps how many files one listing takes on, and a listing that could not finish removes nothing.
The F.T.P. connector has the same fields, plus an Encryption mode, which can be Automatic, None, Explicit F.T.P.S. or Implicit F.T.P.S., and a Data connection of Automatic, Passive or Active.

chapters.title: Give the assistant the data source
chapters.subtitle: Choose it on a profile

steps.text: Now give the assistant the knowledge. Open the profile, open the Knowledge tab, and choose the data source.
Restrict answers to retrieved data only keeps the assistant to your files. When nothing matches, it says so, instead of answering from general knowledge.
Strictness is how closely a passage must match the question, and Retrieved documents is how many passages come back. Click Save.
Now ask a question about the handbook: how many days of annual leave does a full-time employee get?
The assistant answers from the file that the file source read.
Under the answer, the numbered sources show which file the answer came from.
Create the index and a Files data source, point a file source at a folder, and the assistant's knowledge follows the files, without anyone uploading anything. Thanks for watching.
